title: Mana Kak' Abet Abironi
stanzas: Mana kak` abet abiro, ok anyal bet maber kenda,Adwaro rembi moroma yie iwara kuom ng`wononi.
Mana kak` abet ang`eyo, Rembi kende emoroma,Noluoka matar moloyo komiya genoi chutho.
Mana kak` abet abiro,chunya mool ogomboi,Ok anyal bet mabor kodi, Adwaro bet mari chutho.
Chunya gi ngimana duto, Mondo oyud yuweyo kuomi K`ase bayo ma ase ol, Ayuweyo kuom hera mari.
chorus: Kaka abet, kaka abet abironi,O Ruoth winja, gwedha, wara ,kaka abet abironi.
